title: export-localized input
description: Arguments for compose.mjs export. The CLI takes locales as one comma-separated value.

composed.description: A directory written by compose that holds provenance.json.

template.description: Optional template path when the one recorded in provenance is not reachable. Its sha256 must match.

now.description: Optional composedAt for the exports. Defaults to the composedAt of the source provenance.
